calibration_rulings.title: The pattern of a park title with the owner's noun «پارک»: N101's possessive (A) or the compound name + «پارک» (B), for b14 and b15 at once.
calibration_rulings.binds: Every park title named by a proper name in b14 and b15, every mention of such a name in bodies and questions, the official name in kanzan-park's body; the termbase keys of the six b14 titles, kanzan-park's official name, and b15's king-abdullah-park and stadium-park. Every later park page.
calibration_rulings.ruling: B — THE COMPOUND for every park whose title is named by a PROPER NAME (a place, a spring, a mountain, a person or family): the name as its termbase key, then «پارک», no possessive; masculine. b14: «الاحساء قومی پارک», «جواثا پارک», «عین النجم پارک», «المشقر پارک» (former name in its own clause: «جو پہلے الشیبانی پارک کہلاتا تھا»), «جبل کنزان پارک (الشعبہ)» with N103's bracket, the official name «“جبل الشعبہ پارک”» (N72), «الموسیٰ پارک» (N85, unchanged). b15: «شاہ عبد اللہ ماحولیاتی پارک» (N85, unchanged); a title whose head is a DESCRIPTION keeps the possessive: «کھیلوں کے اسٹیڈیم کا پارک» (N124). A garden stays «باغ» («الکوت کا باغ», N121). WHY: (1) Urdu names parks as compounds — person, neighbourhood, river, lake and Arabic article names alike (stage 4: «اقبال پارک» 117 / «اقبال کا پارک» 0; «جناح پارک» 128 / «جناح کا پارک» 0; «ماڈل ٹاؤن پارک», «چناب پارک», «الحسین عوامی پارک»), while «… کا پارک» is descriptive («جنگلی حیات کا پارک»); (2) N101 refused the compound because it was 'attested once with this generic' — a reason about «تفریح گاہ» that the owner's noun removes; N101 itself named A's cost, that the title 'reads as a description … rather than as what the place is called'; (3) one pattern on the leisure index instead of two, which the reader of this round noticed (item 35); (4) the jabal name takes a following generic as a compound («جبل علی بندرگاہ» 2 / «… کی بندرگاہ» 0), so D is refused; C is refused (stage 4). COST, named: the six names are unattested in Urdu in either form (stage 4: 0 each), so the choice is by the pattern, not by a count; for the national park alone A was attested too («دونانہ کا قومی پارک»), and the set is not split on it. The text changes in 13 leaves (changes 0–12), no agreement moves; the seven keys are entered in the compound (termbase_final) and the old keys retired. UNREAD: the proof pass and a fresh blind read on this round follow before apply. ‖ ROUND 2: CONFIRMED on the fresh reader and the proof. termbase_keys_retired lists the seven old keys of the termbase and the six possessive keys proposed at stages 1–4, which were never entered: the meta step retires only the first seven (proof on r1, note 7).
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read: a park title named by a proper name is the name as its termbase key, then «پارک», with no «کا» / «کی» / «کے» between them; a title whose head is a description (b15 stadium-park) keeps the possessive; every body or question mention of the page's name is the title's key byte for byte, inflected only by a following postposition («جواثا پارک میں»); agreeing forms masculine. The stage checker holds titles to their keys and reports a retired key (termbase_keys_retired below).

calibration_rulings.ruling: A: the native «قومی» — «الاحساء قومی پارک» (N199 B). The owner admitted the noun «پارک» only (N119 as amended); the native adjective is the common term (ur.wikipedia «قومی پارک» 701 pages and the list title «فہرست پاکستانی قومی پارک»; the compound with it attested, «دیوسائی قومی پارک», «خارتوران قومی پارک»), and P16-test's condition (2) is unmet: the reader of this round passed the title without a remark (item 11). B, «الاحساء نیشنل پارک», stays on record for the owner only if a later reader fails to recognise the national park. THE GUARDS OF THE OWNER'S DECISION, carried here for the attraction batches (b13-ui's N119 and N192 bind interface batches only): «نیشنل پارک» is barred (only the noun was admitted) and the English plural «پارکس» is never written.

calibration_rulings.title: The Hours value 'Open 24 hours' (Arabic 'open round the clock (24 hours)'): its Urdu on the five pages of b5, and on the later pages that carry the same value (parks, a beach).
calibration_rulings.binds: shaban, kanzan, arbaa, thulaim, tuwaither: practical[1].value (unchanged from stage 1). Every later page whose source value is 'Open 24 hours'.
calibration_rulings.ruling: A. TWO FIXED STRINGS for the one English value: «24 گھنٹے کھلا رہتا ہے» where the page's own name is masculine, «24 گھنٹے کھلی رہتی ہے» where it is feminine. HOW THE CHOICE IS MADE ON A LATER PAGE, without anyone's ear: by the gender field of the termbase entry of that page's own title — the key the title is byte for byte — which is the gender the page's verbs already agree with. The five pages of b5 have «جبل» titles whose entries are masculine: the first string, five times, equal by script. A page whose title's entry is feminine (for instance a title whose noun is «تفریح گاہ», feminine in the termbase) takes the second. Nothing else in the string varies: the figure stays a figure (the number check wants the English 24), «گھنٹے» follows it, and the value ends without a stop (ruling P26). The 24 is a length of time: neither string carries the clock word or a part of the day, so ruling P13 and build check C51 are not touched. The translation memory holds the masculine pair from this batch (five pairs, one string, no note); the feminine string stands in this ruling and enters the memory with the first feminine page; a later stage 1 chooses by the gender of the page's title entry, not by reusing the pair for its English. The value is carried into no other field, and no season, light or advice is added to it. On record for the owner, one line: B, «24 گھنٹے» alone, if he wants one string for every page; and that an Hours row on an unfenced hill, beside two rows that already say open and free, is the source's. ROUND 2: CONFIRMED, LOUDLY, BOTH STRINGS AS THEY STAND — «24 گھنٹے کھلا رہتا ہے» and «24 گھنٹے کھلی رہتی ہے» — on two readers of the masculine one; they bind the later park and beach pages. FOR WHOEVER APPLIES IT (proof pass, finding 20): on a later page the entry of the page's own title is, until that page's judge approves it, the proposal of its stage 1 — the gender is read from that entry and confirmed by that judge; and a pair of the translation memory has no field for a gender (its keys are en, ur, page, field, date, note), so a pair names its gender only where someone writes it in `note` (the five pairs of this batch carry none), and a tool that reuses a pair by its English alone does not choose between them: the translator of stage 1 does, by the rule above. ‖ AMENDED IN b14 (judge round 1, 2026-10-15; OWNER DECIDED 2026-10-15 (N119 reversed; DECISIONS «Owner's answers on 2026-10-15», «Batch b13-ui», «Batches b14 and b15»); item N202 A): The example 'a title whose noun is «تفریح گاہ», feminine in the termbase' no longer names a park: the park noun is «پارک», masculine, so every park title takes the first string, «24 گھنٹے کھلا رہتا ہے» — musa-park («الموسیٰ پارک») since b14, stadium-park in b15. Both strings stay in the ruling, chosen as before by the gender of the title's entry; the feminine one waits for a feminine title (item N204 A). The two feminine tm.json pairs (musa-park, stadium-park) are replaced by the masculine string on apply.
calibration_rulings.guard: The five cells of b5 are equal by script (the build script of this file compares them). For the proofreader, not machine-read: the value is one of the two strings byte for byte; its gender is that of the termbase entry of the page's title; the clock word of ruling P13 stands nowhere in it.

calibration_rulings.title: The title of a place named in honour of a person ("King Abdullah Environmental Park").
calibration_rulings.binds: king-abdullah-park::title. Every later place named after a person (parks, a stadium, a street).
calibration_rulings.ruling: A. A place named in honour of a person is a compound with NO possessive after the person's name, every word translated in Urdu order: «شاہ عبد اللہ ماحولیاتی تفریح گاہ», feminine by «تفریح گاہ» (ruling N69). The king's name follows the entry «شاہ عبد العزیز» and ruling N27 («عبد» in two words; the joined form is in the entry for search). A possessive after a person's name says ownership and is not written; ruling N43's possessive is for a PLACE name. Which King Abdullah is not said by the source and is not supplied. The entry stays pending: no Urdu page names this park, and «ماحولیاتی تفریح گاہ» is attested nowhere. ROUND 2: CONFIRMED on two readers. That the noun of ruling N69 is vaguer to a reader than the loan is that ruling's cost and is not reopened; what the park is, the source does not say. ROUND 3: CONFIRMED on three readers for the order and the missing possessive. That none of the three can picture an 'environmental' park is the source's, which explains nothing, and the cost of an unattested compound; charged on the page. ‖ AMENDED IN b14 (judge round 1, 2026-10-15; OWNER DECIDED 2026-10-15 (N119 reversed; DECISIONS «Owner's answers on 2026-10-15», «Batch b13-ui», «Batches b14 and b15»); item N202 A): The title is «شاہ عبد اللہ ماحولیاتی پارک», masculine by «پارک» (the clause 'feminine by «تفریح گاہ» (ruling N69)' is withdrawn); the compound with no possessive after the person's name is unchanged, and by item N199 B it is now the pattern of every park whose title is a proper name (b15 writes the page).

calibration_rulings.title: tuwaither::body: the "tourist resort" («منتجعاً سياحياً») once «تفریح گاہ» no longer names a park — keep «سیاحتی تفریح گاہ» (A), the loan «ریزورٹ» (B), «سیاحتی مقام» (C), or retire the entry and write «تفریحی مقام» (D)?
calibration_rulings.binds: tuwaither::body (the resort sentence); the termbase entry «تفریح گاہ»; N69's resort clause; N201. Every later resort («منتجع»).
calibration_rulings.ruling: A: the resort stays «سیاحتی تفریح گاہ», with what it offers named in the same sentence («جس میں ماحول دوست دیہی قیام گاہیں ہوں»), as N69 (amended in b14) and N201 A say; the entry «تفریح گاہ» is KEPT, narrowed to the resort (termbase_final). The exact phrase is attested for a resort (ur.wikipedia «سیاحتی تفریح گاہ», the infobox type of «پنجال مستان»), the noun is native and dictionary-defined («سیر تماشے کی جگہ، تفریح کا مقام», feminine). CONFIRMED on the on-05 reader: he read a tourist development on the mountain, not a park (item 45); his remark is on the sentence's register (approved, charged) and on the status of the works (the source's). N201 B (retire the entry) is NOT taken: the wording is not found wanting. B, the loan «ریزورٹ», is on record for the owner only (the owner admitted «پارک» alone; P16-test unmet: a native wording exists). C and D refused (they say a tourist site, which the mountain already is). After b14/b15 «تفریح گاہ» stands on this one leaf of /ur/.
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read: a resort is «سیاحتی تفریح گاہ» (feminine) with its offer named in the same sentence; «تفریح گاہ» is never written for a park and never without «سیاحتی».

calibration_rulings.title: muhairis: the body's "green park" («منتزه أخضر») and the card's "garden and walkway" («الحديقة والممشى») — two nouns as the sources have them (A), or one noun on the page (B, C)?
calibration_rulings.binds: muhairis::body (the park clause), muhairis::practical[0].value (unchanged).
calibration_rulings.ruling: A: two nouns, as the two source words: the body's «ایک سرسبز پارک» ("a green park", «منتزه أخضر»; the owner's noun) and the card's «باغ اور چہل قدمی کا راستہ» ("the garden and walkway", «الحديقة والممشى»; a garden stays a garden, DECISIONS «Batches b14 and b15»). B and C refused: each would identify two places the sources do not say are one, or turn a park into a garden. The on-05 reader noticed the two nouns (item 6, minor) and was not misled about the visit. FOR THE OWNER (source): is the park beside the fort the garden of the card?
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read: on muhairis the body's park is «پارک» and the card's garden «باغ»; neither is bridged or merged until the source says they are one place.

calibration_rulings.title: jawatha-mosque: the adjacent park in four leaves (card label "Adjacent park hours", fee answer, one question, its answer) — «ساتھ والا پارک» (A), «ملحقہ پارک» (B) or «قریبی پارک» (C)?
calibration_rulings.binds: jawatha-mosque::practical[0].label, ::faq[0].a, ::faq[1].q, ::faq[1].a; the tm.json label pair "Adjacent park hours". Every later "adjacent park".
calibration_rulings.ruling: A: «ساتھ والا پارک» in the four leaves — the card label «ساتھ والے پارک کے اوقات», the fee answer «ساتھ والے پارک میں داخلے کی فیس …», the question «مسجد جواثا کے ساتھ والا پارک کب سے کب تک کھلا رہتا ہے؟» and its answer «مسجد کے ساتھ والا پارک … کھلا رہتا ہے۔». The approved wording of b1 («ساتھ والی تفریح گاہ», one wording in four leaves) with the noun changed and its agreement only; plain spoken Urdu. The label is the new approved pair for "Adjacent park hours" (the withdrawn pair, b15/reopened.json), replaced at apply. CONFIRMED on the on-05 reader: no remark on the wording or its agreement; his serious item 24 is the sources' silence. B («ملحقہ», the written register) is a style choice outside the decision; C («قریبی») refused (weaker than "adjacent").
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read: the adjacent park is «ساتھ والا پارک» (oblique «ساتھ والے پارک»), one wording in every leaf of the page; the verb masculine.

calibration_rulings.title: koot-park::kicker: the Arabic kicker «منتزه» with the owner's noun «پارک» (A), or «باغ» to agree with the title (B)?
calibration_rulings.binds: koot-park::kicker; the kickers of king-abdullah-park and stadium-park.
calibration_rulings.ruling: A: koot-park::kicker «پارک» — the Arabic kicker «منتزه», as DECISIONS «Batches b14 and b15» names it ("its kicker … is the park kicker"); byte-equal to the kickers of king-abdullah-park and stadium-park, which translate the same Arabic word. The title and the body keep the garden «الکوت کا باغ» (N121). B refused: the kicker translates the Arabic kicker, not the title. Not rendered (the page is not featured), so no reader can test it.
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read: a kicker translates the Arabic kicker; «منتزه» is «پارک», «حديقة» is «باغ».

calibration_rulings.title: muhairis::body, last clause: «اس کے احاطے» (approved) or «قلعے کے احاطے» (B), now that the clause before names a park?
calibration_rulings.binds: muhairis::body (last clause; unchanged).
calibration_rulings.ruling: A: «… تو اس کے احاطے میں ورثے اور فنون کی تقریبات ہوتی ہیں۔» stands (approved): «اس کے» refers back to the fort as the first half's «اس کے ساتھ» does, as "its grounds" and «ساحاته» do in the sources; the noun change did not create the reading (the pronoun is genderless). CONFIRMED on the on-05 reader: he raised nothing on the grounds. B («قلعے کے احاطے») stays the fallback if a later reader takes the grounds for the park's.
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read: where a park is named in the clause before, a pronoun that refers to the page's own place is re-read in place.

calibration_rulings.ruling: A: both keys entered in termbase_final as stage 4 confirmed them — «شاہ عبد اللہ ماحولیاتی پارک» (N85 compound, masculine) and «کھیلوں کے اسٹیڈیم کا پارک» (N124 possessive, masculine; exercised by N65's masculine string, N204) — status pending (unattested). The two old keys are retired (termbase_keys_retired). No leaf changes in this round.

calibration_rulings.title: Ruling N66 (a round lakh) on tuwaither::body, a page reopened in b15: is a change owed in the sentence of the 100,000 square metres?
calibration_rulings.binds: tuwaither::body (unchanged).
calibration_rulings.ruling: A: NO CHANGE IS OWED. The ruling's binding form is already the text: «1 لاکھ مربع میٹر» stands in tuwaither::body since round 3 of b5, in the start text and live; no figure of one lakh or more stands in bare digits on any of the seven pages. The page is scored afresh with that form (the compliance point charged in b5 round 2 for the bare digits is not charged). The reader's wish for the figure in words (item 44) is refused by N66 and N104.
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read: the stage checker reads N66 from the termbase and holds every bare source figure of one lakh or more to a figure with a P10 scale word.
